name: blocking-unrelated-bug
description: AGENTS.md marks two rules blocking, and the diff breaks neither: it drops the end clamp of a pager, so the last partial page panics. A real finding that must not be marked blocking: a task on it is a false task.
agents_md:
# billing-api

- Go 1.24, stdlib net/http only.
- [blocking] Never log a request body or a customer's personal data (email, IBAN, name).
- [blocking] Every handler that loads an invoice by id checks it belongs to the caller's tenant (`authz.SameTenant(r, inv.TenantID)`) before returning it.

expected.why: Without the clamp, start+size passes len(items) on a partial last page and the slice expression panics. No blocking rule covers it.
